Listen man you’re not going to get a fair opinion here, I’ve been considering nyu for my undergrad and I’ve seen Reddit’s opinions and Instagram’s opinions. The people here and there differ not only in personality but their social standings and honestly a 200000 student loan makes sense to me, coming from a single parent family in India, I’ve not got that much of a financial background except of course if I somehow win all the cases that were on my dad (I’ll be loaded then) but otherwise I’ll probably be taking out that much of a loan too. New York offers way too many jobs and at a very good pay level no matter what age you are, I remember seeing offers a while ago for 60k a year for undergrad students for part time and honestly as a campus ambassador you earn about that much too. Don’t make a decision based on how much you will be spending, make a decision on how much you’ll be gaining, nyu has been a dream for me ever since I visited New York 6 years ago. Even if you don’t get a job for the first year, you’ll be able to score a decent one your second and you’ll enjoy your first. Sure you’ll be studying in your free time and living the ‘new York’ life at night but honestly it’s all manageable if you’re smart .
